conditions: 6 AM- Top o' the morning, Jackson. The slopes will surely rise to meet ya, because St. Patrick's Day 2026 is shaping up to be a gorgeous one here in the Tetons, with warm sunshine to help you chase down those big-mountain leprechauns. Near cloudless conditions will have the high temperatures zooming into the low 30s at the summit and the mid-50s in the Village. Light to moderate west winds will help cool things a tad, as they blow in the 5 to 25 mph range. Don't be concerned by the lack of cold. Sometimes in our search for the elusive pot of white gold, the mountain instead shows us subtle snowy secrets with radical sensations far too phantasmagorical to be told. -Lege
